messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — OceanGrid usage just slid from 68% active seats to 12% this week after their new ML lead joined. Looks like several teams paused flows. Need a quick triage.
Tom (AM): Ugh. Any signal on why? procurement? cost? quality?
Aisha (CSM): Preliminary: procurement flagged cost, ML lead is running a competitor pilot (they mentioned 'fast infer' in notes). Also saw a spike in error-level logs in our SDK around 03/10 in region-us-west.
metrics-bot: automated alert — account=oceangrid metric=active_seats drop=56pct window=7d severity=high
Liam (Solutions): Can you drop the recent error logs here? If it's SDK-related we should patch or offer config workaround ASAP.
Aisha (CSM): Pasted snippet from their ops log: ```ERROR: kvcache overflow at token 1024 -> falling back to unoptimized path
stack: infer/runtime/kvcache.cc:214```
Nora (Sales): Competitive pilot — do we know which model variant they're testing? If it's a perf/cost play we can propose a Dedicated pilot with cost guarantees.
Tom (AM): Good idea. Aisha, can you ask their ML lead (cc @natalie_ocean) if the pilot is about latency/cost or accuracy? Short ask so we don't spook them.
Aisha (CSM): Sent a quick note to Natalie: "Natalie — quick check: is the new pilot focused on latency/cost? We can offer a 6-week Dedicated trial with reserved capacity and a joint tuning session if helpful." Waiting on reply.
Liam (Solutions): In parallel: I can assemble an action bundle — 1) quick config patch for kvcache thresholds, 2) suggestion for batching/quantization profile, 3) cost estimate for a 6-week Dedicated pool. Want me to prepare slides?
Nora (Sales): Yes, prepare a short ROI calc and a 1-pager for procurement showing cost predictability vs the competitor. I'll lead outreach if they respond positively.
metrics-bot: note — historical median latency for oceangrid on redwood-hosted models = 78ms (p50), current = 210ms (p50) after the drop
Tom (AM): Prioritize the config patch. If we can reduce errors in 24h, it might stop churn while we negotiate the pilot. Who owns the patch?
Liam (Solutions): I'll own it. ETA 12-18 hours to validate patch and a short repro. Aisha — can you send latest logs and sample requests?
Aisha (CSM): Sending logs and a minimal repro bundle now. Also added suggested stakeholders: Natalie (ML lead), Priya (procurement).
Nora (Sales): If they want a Dedicated pilot, can we offer a conditional price lock and an SLA for token throughput? I'll confirm with pricing ops.
Tom (AM): Also document next steps for renewal risk: 1) immediate tech triage (Liam) 2) procurement ROI (Nora) 3) customer outreach + offer (Aisha) 4) follow-up check-in in 48h. I'll own the timeline tracker.
Aisha (CSM): Agreed. Putting a 48h cadence. Will update thread when Natalie replies. :eyes:
Nora (Sales): One more — capture any qualitative feedback from their engineers about model quality vs competitor. If it's accuracy, Dedicated won't help; we'll need evals.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. I'll include a short survey in the outreach.
metrics-bot: reminder scheduled — follow-up-check in 48h thread_ts=1726000000
Tom (AM): Thanks all. Let's aim to have patch deployed to their staging by EOD tomorrow.
Liam (Solutions): On it. Posting updates here as I test.
Aisha (CSM): Update 30m later — Natalie replied: "We're most concerned about cost & inf latency. Happy to try your Dedicated pilot if it reduces costs and gives stable latency." Moving to action.
Nora (Sales): Great. I'll draft the procurement pitch and price lock.
Tom (AM): Perfect — stand-up meeting in 30 to sync owners.
Aisha (CSM): Meeting invite sent. Closing loop here for now, will add notes after patch validation"
